DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見つからないとのご相談ですね。最後に確認した場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here because you can't find your bicycle, correct? Please tell me where you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の夜、駅前の駐輪場の中央の列に止めました。今朝戻ったら、その辺りにありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日夜に駅前駐輪場の中央列へ止め今朝見つからなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Last night I parked it in the middle row of the bicycle parking area in front of the station. When I returned this morning, it wasn't anywhere around there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you parked in the middle row of the station bicycle parking area last night and couldn't find it this morning. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中央の列ですね。管理者に移動されていないか、もう確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The middle row, then. Have you checked whether the management moved it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 管理室にはまだ聞いていません。盗まれたと決めつけず、先に移動の有無も確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 管理室未確認を伝え盗難と断定せず移動の有無を確かめたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't asked the management office yet. Rather than assume it was stolen, I'd like to check first whether it was moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't checked with the management office and want to establish whether it was moved without assuming theft. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでも事情を伺います。自転車を区別できる特徴や、登録に関する控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll take the details here too. Are there any distinguishing features or a copy of its registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緑色で後ろに黒いかごがあります。防犯登録の控えは家に置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 緑の車体と黒い後かごを説明し登録控えは自宅にあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's green with a black basket on the back. The copy of the theft-prevention registration is at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the green frame and black rear basket, and say the registration copy is at home. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴を記録します。管理室で確認できた結果と控えがあれば、その後の相談に役立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record those features. The results of your inquiry at the management office and the registration copy will help with any further consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理室には、最後に止めた列と時間を伝えます。移動されていなかった場合は、控えを持って戻ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理室へ列と時間を伝え移動がなければ控えを持って再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell the management office the row and time I last parked it. If it wasn't moved, I'll return with the registration copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll give the management office the row and time and return for further advice with the registration copy if it wasn't moved. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、場所と時間のメモも残してください。見つかった場合も、今回の相談についてお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please also keep a note of the location and time. If you find it, let us know in connection with this report too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日の夜に中央の列へ止めたことをメモします。管理室へ確認して、結果をこちらに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駐輪状況をメモし管理室確認結果を警察へ伝えると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note that I parked in the middle row last night. I'll ask the management office and report the results here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll note the parking details and report the management office's findings to the police. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認のために無理に立入禁止の場所へ入らないでください。お気をつけて。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Don't enter any restricted area to try to check. Take care. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この封筒の宛名が少しにじんでいますね。お送り先の番地を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The address on this envelope is a little smudged. Can you check the destination street number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨にぬらしてしまいました。番地は携帯の住所録に残っていますが、このまま送るのは心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒が雨でにじみ番地は携帯住所録に残るが現状で送るのが不安と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It got wet in the rain. The street number is saved in my phone's address book, but I'm worried about sending it like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that rain smudged the envelope, the street number is saved on your phone, and you're worried about mailing it as it is. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 数字が区別しにくいので、はっきり書き直すことをおすすめします。中の書類もぬれていないか、ご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The numbers are hard to distinguish, so I recommend rewriting them clearly. Please check for yourself whether the documents inside are wet too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社へ出す書類なので、中身を見てから新しい封筒に入れ直したいです。今はまだ受け付けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社書類を確認し別封筒へ移す間は受付を進めないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're documents for my company, so I'd like to check them and put them in a new envelope. Please don't accept the mailing yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask staff to hold off on accepting the mailing while you check the company documents and transfer them to another envelope. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。受付は進めません。新しい封筒をご用意できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. I won't process it. Do you have a new envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かばんに一枚あります。中の書類は乾いていたので、こちらに移して住所録を見ながら書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予備封筒があり中身は乾いていたため住所録を見て書き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have one in my bag. The documents inside were dry, so I'll transfer them to this one and write the address using my address book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a spare envelope and the contents are dry, so you'll rewrite the address using your address book. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き終わったら、郵便番号と番地を元の住所と照らしてからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've written it, compare the postal code and street number against the original address before bringing it back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい封筒に書きました。差出人の住所も裏に書いたので、表と裏の字が読めるか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新封筒の宛名と裏の差出人住所が読みやすいか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written the new envelope. I wrote the sender's address on the back too; could you check whether the writing on both sides is legible?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check that the destination address and sender's address on the back of the new envelope are readable. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どちらも読み取れます。送付方法を選ぶ前に、普通に送るか配達状況を確認できる方法にするか、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both are readable. Before we choose a mailing method, would you prefer ordinary mail or a method that lets you check the delivery status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回は配達状況を確認できる方法を相談したいです。内容物の入れ替えが済んだこの封筒で、料金と方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入替済み封筒を配達状況確認可能な方法で送りたいと希望し料金等を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: This time I'd like to discuss a method that lets me check delivery status. Please tell me the price and options for this envelope now that I've transferred the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a delivery-status-checking mailing method and its cost for the envelope with the contents already transferred. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では対応する方法と料金をご案内します。お手続き後は控えを保管してください。本日はありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain the available methods and prices. Keep your receipt after completing the procedure. Thank you for coming today. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先を入力しました。送金する前に、画面の受取人名をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I've entered the destination account. Before we send the money, please check the recipient's name on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 契約書にある会社名とは違います。間違って送らないよう、まだ実行しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取名義が契約書の会社名と異なるため送金未実行の維持を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's different from the company name on the contract. Please don't execute the transfer yet, to avoid sending it to the wrong place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the recipient's name differs from the company on your contract and request that the transfer remain unexecuted. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送金は実行していません。入力した銀行名と口座番号を、お持ちの書類と照らしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The transfer hasn't been executed. Let's compare the entered bank name and account number against your documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 銀行名と番号は書類と同じです。でも、この別の名義で家賃が届くのかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀行名と番号は一致するが別名義で家賃が届くかわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bank name and number match the documents. But I don't know whether my rent will reach the right place under this other name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the bank name and number match but you don't know whether rent will reach the correct recipient under a different account name. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号が一致していても、意図した受取先かどうかをこちらから保証することはできません。契約先にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even if the number matches, we can't guarantee that it's the recipient you intend. Please check with the party to your contract.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約書に載っている連絡先へ自分で電話して確認します。それまで今日の振込みは中止します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約書の連絡先へ確認するため今日の振込みを中止すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll call the contact listed on the contract myself to check. I'll cancel today's transfer until then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to cancel today's transfer while you check with the contact listed on your contract. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承りました。振込依頼は取り消します。送金を実行していないことも、この場で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll cancel the transfer request. We'll also confirm here that the money hasn't been sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取消しが済んだら、持ってきた振込用紙は返してください。確認後に必要なら書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取消し後に振込用紙を返してもらい確認後必要なら書き直すと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once it's canceled, please return the transfer form I brought. I'll rewrite it if necessary after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for your transfer form back after cancellation and say you'll rewrite it if necessary after checking. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取消しは済み、送金は行われていません。こちらが用紙です。お名前や番号が書かれていますので、なくさないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's canceled, and no money has been sent. Here's the form. It has your name and numbers on it, so please don't lose it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用紙を受け取りました。契約先から正しい受取人名を確認してから、改めて振込方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙受領を確認し正しい名義を契約先に確認後再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the form. I'll confirm the correct recipient's name with the party to my contract, then ask again about how to make the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm receipt of the form and say you'll seek advice again after checking the correct account name with the contracting party. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 不一致に気づいた段階で止められてよかったです。本日はこれで終了です。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's good we could stop when you noticed the discrepancy. That's everything for today. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手に取った商品のお値段についてですか。どの表示をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the price of the product you're holding? Which sign were you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この棚の特売札を見ました。手に持っている袋も、その値段だと思って選んだのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の特売札を見て手持ち袋も同額と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw the sale sign on this shelf. I chose this bag thinking it was the same price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you saw the shelf's sale sign and thought the bag in your hand had that price too. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 札には小さい二百グラムの袋とあります。お持ちなのは五百グラムで、別の商品価格になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sign says the small 200-gram bag. Yours is 500 grams, so it has a different product price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 容量を見落としていました。小さい方を二つ買うか、大きい方を一つにするか比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容量を見落としたことを伝え小袋二つと大袋一つの価格を比較したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I overlooked the weight. I'd like to compare buying two small bags with one large bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you overlooked the weight and want to compare the prices of two small bags and one large bag. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの価格表示はこちらです。必要な量と合わせて比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are the respective price labels. Compare them alongside the quantity you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使うのは四百グラムくらいです。小さい二袋なら使い切れそうなので、二百グラムを二つにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要量が約四百グラムなので二百グラムを二袋に決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use about 400 grams. I think I can use up two small bags, so I'll take two 200-gram bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose two 200-gram bags because you need around 400 grams. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい袋は上の段です。お持ちの大きい袋はこちらで棚へ戻しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The small bags are on the upper shelf. Shall I put the large bag you're holding back for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。小さい袋を二つ取りましたが、一つの袋の端が破れているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大袋の返却を頼み小袋一つの端の破れを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I've taken two small bags, but the edge of one looks torn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask staff to return the large bag and report a tear at the edge of one small bag. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その袋はお預かりします。破れのない物を一つお持ちしました。こちらと交換してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take that bag. I've brought an undamaged one; please exchange it for this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 交換した二袋はどちらも二百グラムで、破れもありません。この二つを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換後の二袋の容量と破損なしを確認して購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both bags after the exchange are 200 grams and neither is torn. I'll buy these two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the weight and undamaged condition of the two bags after the exchange and say you'll buy them. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 容量と袋を確認していただきありがとうございます。レジへお進みください。またのご来店をお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking the weights and bags. Please go to the register. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 植え込みの方を気にされていましたね。何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking toward the bushes. Has something happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さな鳥が地面にいて、近づいても飛びません。けがをしているのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地面にいる鳥が近づいても飛ばずけがの可能性があると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a small bird on the ground, and it doesn't fly away even when I approach. It may be injured.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that a bird on the ground doesn't fly when approached and may be injured. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場所か教えてください。触ったり持ち上げたりせず、そのまま離れてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where it is. Don't touch or pick it up; stay back and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い花の花壇の奥です。犬を連れた人が近づきそうなので、場所だけ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤い花壇奥の位置を示し犬が近づきそうだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's behind the flower bed with red flowers. Someone with a dog looks about to approach, so I'll just point out the location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the location behind the red flower bed and say a dog may approach. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所はわかりました。私が確認し、必要な連絡先に相談します。ほかの人や犬が近づかないよう、少し離れた所から声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I understand the location. I'll check and consult the appropriate contact if necessary. I'll speak to people from a little distance to keep others and dogs from approaching.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私も鳥のそばには行きません。持っているパンを置くのもやめた方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分も近づかずパンを与えることも控えるべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't go near the bird either. I suppose I shouldn't leave the bread I have for it, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll stay away too and check whether you should also refrain from giving it bread. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、食べ物や水を与えずにお願いします。原因はまだわからないので、こちらで状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Please don't give it food or water. We don't know the cause yet, so we'll check its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真を撮ろうと近づかず、ここで待ちます。場所の説明が済んだら、そのまま帰ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影で近づかず待つと伝え説明後は帰ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here without approaching to take a photo. Once I've explained the location, is it okay for me to go home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait without approaching for a photo and ask if you may go home after explaining the location. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ええ、必要な情報は伺いました。私が対応を引き継ぎますので、お帰りいただいて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I have the information I need. I'll take over from here, so you're welcome to go home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、鳥には触らず、パンも置かないで帰ります。確認をよろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鳥に触らず餌を置かず帰ると確認し担当へ確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll leave without touching the bird or putting down bread. Please check on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll leave without touching the bird or leaving food and ask the staff member to check. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせいただきありがとうございました。足元に気をつけてお帰りください。それでは、さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Watch your footing on the way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の前でお困りですか。切符はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help here by the ticket gates? Do you have a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切符は持っていますが、改札の外の待合室に帽子を忘れました。取りに戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切符を持っていることと改札外に帽子を忘れたことを伝え、取りに戻りたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a ticket, but I left my hat in the waiting room outside the gates. I'd like to go back to get it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have a ticket and left a hat outside the gates, and ask to go back to retrieve it. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その切符を拝見します。もう列車には乗りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see your ticket? Have you boarded a train already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ乗っていません。改札に入ってから帽子がないことに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ乗車しておらず改札に入った後に帽子の紛失に気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I noticed I didn't have my hat after entering the gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you haven't boarded yet and noticed the missing hat after entering the gates. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗車前ですね。帽子を置いた場所と特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: So this was before boarding. Please tell me where you left the hat and what it looks like.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口に近い長い椅子の上です。紺色で、横に白いボタンが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口近くの椅子に置いた紺色の帽子で白いボタンが付いていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the long bench near the entrance. It's navy blue with a white button on the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the navy hat with a white button was left on the bench near the entrance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。いったんここでお待ちください。待合室を確認してから、戻る際の切符の扱いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please wait here for now. I'll check the waiting room, then explain how your ticket will be handled if you go back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 列車まであと十五分あります。見つからなかった場合は、忘れ物の届けを出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出発まで十五分あると伝え、見つからない場合の忘れ物の届けについて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are fifteen minutes until my train. If it isn't found, can I file a lost-property report?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there are fifteen minutes until departure and ask about filing a report if the hat isn't found. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届けの方法もご案内できます。まず確認しますので、切符はご自分でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I can explain how to report it too. I'll check first, so please keep your ticket with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、切符を持ったままここで待ちます。列車の時間が近づいたら声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符を持って待ち、列車の時間が近づいたら駅員に声をかけると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Okay, I'll wait here with my ticket. I'll let you know when it's getting close to my train time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait holding your ticket and alert the station staff as departure time approaches. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認後にお呼びします。お帰りの際もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll call you once I've checked. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書のご記入は進んでいますか。分からない欄があればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: How is the application form coming along? Let us know if there are any fields you don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生年月日の欄に今日の日付を書いてしまいました。まだ提出していませんが、どう直せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 生年月日欄に今日の日付を書いたことと未提出であることを伝え、訂正方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote today's date in the date-of-birth field. I haven't submitted it yet; how should I correct it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you wrote today's date in the birth-date field and haven't submitted the form, and ask how to correct it. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用紙を確認しますね。この欄だけの間違いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check the form. Is this the only field with a mistake?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、名前と住所は合っています。日付だけ消しゴムで消そうとしたら、紙が少し破れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他の欄は正しく、日付を消そうとして用紙が少し破れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, my name and address are correct. I tried to erase just the date with an eraser, and the paper tore a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the other fields are correct and the paper tore slightly when you tried to erase the date. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 破れた用紙では読み取りに支障が出るかもしれません。新しい用紙をお渡ししますので、書き直していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: A torn form may be difficult to read or process. I'll give you a new one; could you fill it in again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書き直します。今の用紙を見ながら写しても大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新しい用紙に書き直すと答え、元の用紙を見ながら写してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll do that. May I copy the information while looking at this form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to fill in a new form and ask whether you may refer to the original while copying. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、お手元で見比べてください。生年月日は、こちらの見本の書き方を参考にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, keep them beside you and compare them. For the date of birth, refer to this example of how to write it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見本は和暦ですが、西暦で書きたい場合は、この欄に西暦と添えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 和暦の見本を見て、西暦と明記して記入してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The example uses the Japanese era calendar. If I want to use the Western calendar, should I add “Western calendar” in this field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Looking at the era-calendar example, ask if you may write the date with an explicit Western-calendar label. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この用紙では西暦で記入できます。年の前に西暦と書いてください。書き終わったら確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may use the Western calendar on this form. Write “Western calendar” before the year. I'll check it when you've finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。新しい用紙に西暦で書いて、提出する前にもう一度見ていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 西暦で新しい用紙に記入し、提出前に職員へ確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll fill in the new form using the Western calendar and ask you to check it again before I submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll fill in the new form using Western years and have staff check it before submission. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、新しい用紙をどうぞ。記入後はこの窓口へお戻りください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the new form. Come back to this counter once you've filled it in. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査室の前でお待ちの方ですね。何か確認されたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're waiting outside the examination room, correct? Is there something you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先ほど名前が聞こえた気がしますが、私の呼び出しか分かりませんでした。もう順番が過ぎていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の名前が呼ばれたか分からず、順番が過ぎているかを看護師に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I heard my name earlier, but I wasn't sure I was being called. Has my turn already passed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the nurse whether your turn has passed because you're unsure whether your name was called. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と、受付で渡された番号を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me your name and the number you received at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエン・アンです。番号は二十六番で、この検査の案内を受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前がグエン・アン、番号が二十六番であると伝え検査案内を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm Nguyen An. My number is 26, and I received these examination instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your name, Nguyen An, and number 26, and show the examination instructions. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内を確認します。二十六番の方の順番を担当者に確かめますので、この椅子で少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the instructions. I'll ask the person in charge about number 26's turn, so please wait a moment in this chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。耳が聞こえにくいので、呼ぶときに近くまで来ていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 耳が聞こえにくいため近くで呼びかけてほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Okay. I have difficulty hearing, so it would help if you could come near me when calling me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you have difficulty hearing and ask to be called from nearby. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者に伝えますね。こちらに来る前に、お手洗いへ行く必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the person in charge. Do you need to use the restroom before coming in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は大丈夫です。ただ、検査の前に水を飲んでよいか聞いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今はお手洗いが不要と答え、検査前に水を飲んでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm okay for now. But I'd like to ask whether I may drink water before the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you don't need the restroom now and ask whether you may drink water before the examination. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 検査によって準備が違いますので、この案内と担当者の指示を確認します。確認するまではお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Preparation differs by examination, so I'll check these instructions and what the person in charge says. Please wait until I've confirmed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、水は確認していただいてからにします。この椅子で呼び出しを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲水の確認が済むまで水を飲まず、指定の椅子で呼び出しを待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Okay, I'll wait for you to check before drinking water. I'll wait in this chair to be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't drink until permission is confirmed and will wait in the designated chair to be called. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。順番と飲水の指示が分かりましたらお知らせします。診察後のお帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll let you know once I've confirmed your turn and instructions about water. Take care on your way home after the consultation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちになった物について伺います。どちらで拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'd like to ask about the item you brought. Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園の向かいの歩道で、この鍵を拾いました。落とした人が困っていると思って届けに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園の向かいの歩道で鍵を拾い届けに来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found this key on the sidewalk across from the park. I thought the person who lost it would be having trouble, so I brought it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found the key on the sidewalk across from the park and brought it in. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届けていただきありがとうございます。拾った時刻と、詳しい場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for bringing it. Please tell me the time and exact place you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後三時ごろです。信号を渡った先の、赤い自動販売機の足元にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午後三時ごろ信号の先の赤い自動販売機の足元で拾ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around three in the afternoon. It was at the foot of the red vending machine beyond the pedestrian crossing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you found it around 3 p.m. at the foot of the red vending machine beyond the crossing. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鍵には青い札が付いていますね。拾った後、誰かに渡したり、使ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The key has a blue tag. After finding it, did you give it to anyone or use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 誰にも渡していませんし、使ってもいません。袋に入れて、そのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人に渡さず使用せず、袋に入れて持ってきたと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't handed it to anyone or used it. I put it in a bag and brought it straight here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you didn't give it to anyone or use it and brought it in a bag. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。届け出の記録を作ります。お名前と連絡先は、こちらの用紙にご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll make a report record. Please enter your name and contact details on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡先は携帯電話の番号を書きます。後から鍵の件で問い合わせるときは、何を伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯番号を記入すると伝え、後日問い合わせる際に必要な情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write my mobile number as the contact. What should I provide if I ask about the key later?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll write your mobile number and ask what information is needed for a later inquiry. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受理した際の番号と、届けた日をお伝えください。照会できる内容には範囲がありますので、その都度確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Give the acceptance number and the date you handed it in. There are limits to the information we can disclose, so we'll check each time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、渡していただく番号を控えておきます。鍵が見つかった場所も、地図で指しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受理番号を控え、拾った場所を地図で示したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll note the number you give me. I'd also like to point out where I found the key on a map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll note the acceptance number and offer to show the place where you found it on a map. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 地図での確認もお願いします。ご協力ありがとうございました。お帰りの道中、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please help us confirm it on the map too. Thank you for your cooperation. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお送りになるのですね。中身は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're mailing this envelope, correct? What's inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申込書と、小さく折った布が一枚入っています。布の部分だけ膨らんでいますが、このまま送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申込書と折った布が入っていて布の部分だけ膨らんでいると伝え、発送できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: An application form and one small folded piece of cloth. Only the cloth portion bulges; can I send it like this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the envelope contains an application and folded cloth, with a bulge only at the cloth, and ask if it can be mailed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 厚さと重さを測って、利用できる送り方を確認します。布は封筒の中で動く状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll measure its thickness and weight to check which mailing methods are available. Can the cloth move around inside the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端に寄ってしまいます。書類にしわが付かないよう、布を別の小袋に入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 布の小袋が端に寄ることと書類のしわを防ぐため袋に入れたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It slides to one end. I put the cloth in a separate little bag to keep the documents from getting creased.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the cloth's little bag slides to one end and was used to prevent creases in the documents. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その小袋を内側で固定すると、偏りを抑えられそうです。封筒の破れも防げるよう、梱包を整えてからもう一度測りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Securing that little bag inside should help keep it from shifting. Let's adjust the packaging to prevent the envelope tearing too, then measure it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手元のテープで小袋を固定します。宛先を書いた面にテープを貼っても問題ありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小袋を固定すると伝え、宛先面にテープを貼ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll secure the little bag with the tape I have. Is it okay to put tape on the side with the address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll secure the little bag and ask whether tape may be placed on the address side. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先が隠れたり読みにくくなったりしないようにしてください。封をした後は、こちらの台でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Make sure it doesn't cover the address or make it hard to read. Once sealed, we'll take it at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、裏側から留めます。布が入っていることは、封筒の表にも書く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏側から留めると伝え、布が入っている旨を表に書く必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll secure it from the back. Do I also need to write on the front that there's cloth inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll secure it from the back and ask whether the front needs a note that cloth is inside. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この送り方で必要な記載を確認してご案内します。まず梱包後の厚さを測りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check and explain what labeling this mailing method requires. First, I'll measure the thickness after packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。測っていただいてから料金と送り方を決め、窓口で支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 梱包後の測定を依頼し、料金と送り方を確認して窓口で払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. After you've measured it, I'll decide on the price and mailing method, then pay at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request measurement after packaging, and say you'll check the price and method and pay at the counter. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。お品物を拝見します。発送後の控えもご確認ください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let me see the item. Please check your mailing receipt afterward too. Take care on your way home.
